- Backend & APIs: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Flask

- Data & Machine Learning: Pandas, Scikit-learn, TF-IDF / NLP, Weka ML, BeautifulSoup4
- Desktop & Core CS: Java SE, Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Docker, Git

## Featured Projects
- Verixa (Flagship Live Deployment — https://verixa-phi.vercel.app): Property decision intelligence platform backed by RERA regulatory filings, builder credibility analytics, spatial locality data (PostGIS), and price trend modeling.
- Exertia: Unified workforce management and privacy-first telemetry operating system pairing a React workspace with a Python background desktop daemon.
- Veritas: Python and Flask local civic news analysis and TF-IDF cosine-similarity perspective clustering engine.
- Smart Inventory: ACID-compliant Java SE and PostgreSQL JDBC demand forecasting and automated Twilio SMS replenishment system using Weka ML.
- Smart GST Invoice: Automated B2B GST computation, ZXing 2D barcode encoding, and iText PDF synthesis desktop utility in Java SE.
